text: Went to this dental clinic as it was near to my hotel and review was good so far. Went for general cleaning and was recommended airflow and filling. Towards the end of the treatment, I felt a sharp pain at my left cheek as the assistant poke the suction tube onto the inner part of my cheek. I asked for them to stop and when I look into the mirror my cheek was so swollen it looked like I stuffed a pingpong in my cheek! The dentist said it's water that got in and the swell will ease in about 24hrs. It got worse at night...it was so painful that I couldn't sleep. The swell was there for 3 days and I went to a doctor, was told it was a muscle trauma. It's an experience that I do not want anyone to go through.
